payload.reason: The evidence indicates that while off-the-shelf NLP systems can be utilized, many industrial dialogue systems still rely on handcrafted rules and components, suggesting a hybrid approach rather than solely off-the-shelf systems.

claims.text: Many industrially deployed dialogue systems still use manual features or handcrafted rules, indicating reliance on non-off-the-shelf methods.
End-to-end systems, while promising, are not yet suitable for commercial use, suggesting that off-the-shelf solutions are not fully adopted.
Hybrid models combining rule-based and trainable components are common, indicating a blend of off-the-shelf and custom solutions.
